faqEntries.heading: Why can't I find the Grumble?
faqEntries.content: The Grumble does not spawn until you unlock it. Search underground in cold biomes for a frozen Grumble fossil and use a lava bucket on it. After that, Grumbles and their nests start appearing in deserts, forests and savannas.

faqEntries.heading: How do I tame a dinosaur?
faqEntries.content: Hold the food that species likes and interact with it repeatedly until hearts appear. Every attempt has a chance to work, and rarer or more dangerous dinosaurs take more tries. The Swiftstride is different: you tame it by mounting it and holding on until it accepts you.

faqEntries.heading: How do I make my eggs hatch faster?
faqEntries.content: Place the egg in a nest. Use a Furry Carpet, crafted from Mammosk fur, on that nest to turn it into a cosy nest, which is faster again. Nests you find in the world also respawn eggs over time.

faqEntries.heading: Can I stop my baby dinosaur from growing up?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Feed it a Golden Dandelion, crafted from eight gold nuggets around a dandelion, and it stays a baby for good. Feed it another whenever you want it to start growing again.

faqEntries.heading: Can I ride every dinosaur?
faqEntries.content: Every dinosaur can be ridden once tamed, apart from the Bloomdodo. Tame it, interact while holding a saddle, then interact again to ride. Several can also carry a chest for extra storage.

howToEntries.heading: Find your first dinosaur
howToEntries.content: Dinosaurs spawn all over the world, each in its own habitat. Look for the Spikeback and Thorncrest in forests, the Sandrunner in deserts and mesas, the Mammosk and Frosthorn in snowy biomes, and the Coralback out in the open ocean. The Nether and the End have species of their own.

howToEntries.heading: Tame it
howToEntries.content: Almost every dinosaur can be tamed. Hold the food that species likes and interact with it again and again until hearts appear. Rarer and more dangerous dinosaurs take longer. The Swiftstride is the exception: mount it and hold on until it stops throwing you off.

howToEntries.heading: Saddle up and ride
howToEntries.content: Interact with a tamed dinosaur while holding a saddle, then interact again to ride. Many have an ability you trigger by interacting while riding. The Rocktail smashes stone, the Spikeback clears trees, the Ironthumb harvests and replants your crops, and the Coralback lets you breathe underwater.

howToEntries.heading: Hatch eggs and raise babies
howToEntries.content: Twelve species lay eggs. Put an egg in a nest to hatch it faster, or use a Furry Carpet on the nest to make it cosy and faster again. Feed a baby a Golden Dandelion to stop it growing up, and another to let it grow. Use a honeycomb on an egg to stop it hatching, and an axe to undo that.

howToEntries.heading: Craft dinosaur gear
howToEntries.content: Dinosaurs drop materials you cannot get anywhere else. Heavy Leather Armor comes from the Ironthumb, Feather Armor from the Ashclaw protects you from fire, and the Razorjaw Skull disguises you from its pack. Eat a Shimmer Feather to glow in the dark, or craft the Dino Flute to call your tamed dinosaurs.
